blocks.zh: Section 8: Needle-Shield Requirements 針頭護罩需求
blocks.en: Section 8: Needle-Shield Requirements

blocks.zh: 針頭護罩的功能、材料特性、機械性能與容器密封完整性要求
blocks.en: Needle-shield function, material properties, mechanical performance and container closure integrity requirements

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解針頭護罩（非硬質 / 硬質 RNS）的兩種類型及其在 PFS 中的密封功能
blocks.en: Understand the two types of needle shield (non-rigid and rigid needle shield, RNS) and their sealing function in a PFS

blocks.zh: 掌握熱固性橡膠與熱塑性彈性體（TPE/TPV）配方對滅菌相容性、可萃取物及藥品相容性的影響
blocks.en: Understand how thermoset rubber and thermoplastic elastomer (TPE/TPV) formulations affect sterilization compatibility, extractables and drug product compatibility

blocks.zh: 了解可萃取物（Extractables）與滲出物（Leachables）的監管要求（USP <381>、EP 3.2.9、ISO 10993）
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory expectations for extractables and leachables (USP <381>, EP 3.2.9, ISO 10993)

blocks.zh: 能夠解釋針頭護罩拔除力（Pull-off Force）的規格設定原則及其與 CCI 和自動注射器相容性的關聯
blocks.en: Be able to explain the principles for setting the needle-shield pull-off force specification and how it relates to CCI and autoinjector compatibility

blocks.zh: 識別 EO / 蒸汽 / E-beam 三種滅菌方式對針頭護罩材料選擇的不同要求
blocks.en: Identify the different requirements that EO, steam and e-beam sterilization place on needle-shield material selection

blocks.zh: 認識空針與充填後針頭護罩的 CCI 驗證策略差異
blocks.en: Recognize the differences in CCI verification strategy between empty and filled syringes

blocks.zh: 理解針頭護罩尺寸相容性對組合產品（Combination Product）開發的重要性
blocks.en: Understand why needle-shield dimensional compatibility matters for combination product development

blocks.zh: 8.0 Needle-Shield Requirements 針頭護罩需求
blocks.en: 8.0 Needle-Shield Requirements

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 針頭護罩（Needle Shield）是 PFS 安全性的第一道防線，直接影響：（1）微生物屏障（防止汙染）、（2）針尖保護（防止損傷）、（3）產品密封（CCI）、以及（4）使用者操作性（拔除力）。Section 8 涵蓋功能、材料、機械性能與 CCI 四大主軸。
blocks.en: The needle shield is the first line of defense for PFS safety and directly affects: (1) the microbial barrier (preventing contamination), (2) needle tip protection (preventing damage), (3) product sealing (CCI), and (4) user handling (pull-off force). Section 8 covers four main themes: function, materials, mechanical performance and CCI.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 針頭護罩就像外科手術刀的刀片保護套——既要保護刀刃不受汙染，又要讓醫生能夠輕鬆單手拔除，還必須確保在運輸振動中不脫落。這三個要求相互制衡，正是 Section 8 的設計核心挑戰。
blocks.en: A needle shield is like the protective sheath on a surgical scalpel blade: it must keep the blade free from contamination, let the surgeon remove it easily with one hand, and stay in place during transport vibration. These three requirements pull against one another, which is the core design challenge of Section 8.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本 section 與 TR73 的其他章節高度相互參照：§14.3（相容性）、§12.0（CCI）、§11.1.1（彈性體配方）、§5.3（E&L）。在 Amaran 承接含針頭護罩的 PFS 專案時，這些章節需並行審查，不可孤立評估。
blocks.en: This section is heavily cross-referenced with other parts of TR73: §14.3 (compatibility), §12.0 (CCI), §11.1.1 (elastomer formulation) and §5.3 (E&L). When Amaran takes on a PFS project that includes a needle shield, these sections must be reviewed in parallel and not assessed in isolation.

blocks.zh: 8.1 Functions of the Needle Shield 針頭護罩的功能
blocks.en: 8.1 Functions of the Needle Shield

blocks.zh: Interference Fit（干涉配合）：彈性體針頭護罩的外徑略大於玻璃錐頭的內徑，壓配後產生預壓力，形成物理性密封。這是 PFS 針頭端 CCI 的主要機制，與橡膠塞的「cork-in-bottle」原理相同。
blocks.en: Interference fit: The inner diameter of the elastomeric needle shield is slightly smaller than the outer diameter of the glass tip (cone), so press-fitting creates a pre-load that forms a physical seal. This is the main CCI mechanism at the needle end of a PFS and works on the same "cork-in-bottle" principle as a rubber stopper.

blocks.zh: 非硬質護罩 vs 硬質護罩（RNS）：
blocks.en: Non-rigid shield vs rigid needle shield (RNS):

blocks.zh: 非硬質（Soft）：純彈性體，成本低，常用於手動注射的 PFS
blocks.en: Non-rigid (soft): Pure elastomer; low cost; commonly used for manually injected PFS

blocks.zh: RNS：彈性體外加塑料外殼，抗衝擊性更高，操作更直觀，適合自動注射器（autoinjector）及安全裝置，且可加入防拆（tamper evidence）設計
blocks.en: RNS: Elastomer with an added plastic outer shell; higher impact resistance and more intuitive handling; suited to autoinjectors and safety devices; can incorporate tamper-evidence features

blocks.zh: 非硬質護罩像軟木塞——彈性好、密封佳，但容易損壞。RNS 像帶金屬外殼的香檳塞——外殼提供剛性保護，內部軟木仍負責密封。自動注射器需要精確的拔除力曲線，因此 RNS 的可預測性更受青睞。
blocks.en: A non-rigid shield is like a cork: flexible and good at sealing, but easily damaged. An RNS is like a champagne stopper with a metal cage: the shell provides rigid protection while the cork inside still does the sealing. Autoinjectors need a precise pull-off force profile, so the predictability of an RNS is preferred.

blocks.zh: 滅菌相容性要求分兩種情境：
blocks.en: Sterilization compatibility requirements fall into two scenarios:

blocks.zh: 供應商提供 Ready-for-Filling（RFF） 預裝針頭護罩：通常用 EO 滅菌，彈性體須允許 EO 氣體穿透
blocks.en: Supplier provides Ready-for-Filling (RFF) syringes with pre-assembled needle shields: usually sterilized by EO, so the elastomer must allow EO gas to penetrate

blocks.zh: 藥廠散裝採購自行組裝：通常用 蒸汽滅菌（autoclaving），彈性體須耐受高溫高壓
blocks.en: Drug manufacturer purchases bulk components and assembles them in-house: usually steam sterilization (autoclaving), so the elastomer must withstand high temperature and pressure

blocks.zh: Amaran 作為 CDMO，在接收空針時須確認供應商採用何種情境，以確保滅菌相容性資料已涵蓋在 DMF 中。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, when receiving empty syringes Amaran must confirm which scenario the supplier uses, to ensure the sterilization compatibility data are covered in the DMF.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若 RNS 的塑料外殼阻擋 EO 氣體滲透，製造商應如何在設計層面解決此問題？
blocks.en: If the plastic shell of an RNS blocks EO gas penetration, how should the manufacturer solve this at the design level?

blocks.zh: Interference fit 的壓配力過高或過低，各會對 CCI 和針頭護罩拔除力產生什麼影響？
blocks.en: What effect does an interference-fit force that is too high or too low have on CCI and on needle-shield pull-off force?

blocks.zh: 8.2 Material Property Requirements 材料性能要求
blocks.en: 8.2 Material Property Requirements

blocks.zh: 熱固性橡膠（Thermoset Rubber）：以共價鍵交聯，成型後不可再加工。交聯點是永久性的化學鍵，類似硫化橡膠。優點：力學強度高、耐老化；缺點：廢料不可回收。
blocks.en: Thermoset rubber: Cross-linked by covalent bonds and cannot be reprocessed after molding. The cross-links are permanent chemical bonds, similar to vulcanized rubber. Advantages: high mechanical strength and good aging resistance; disadvantage: scrap cannot be recycled.

blocks.zh: 熱塑性彈性體（TPE/TPV）：以物理交聯（苯乙烯嵌段共聚物）或動態硫化（TPV）提供彈性。TPE 可回收再加工；TPV 含已交聯的橡膠相，兼具 TPE 加工性與熱固性橡膠的耐久性。
blocks.en: Thermoplastic elastomer (TPE/TPV): Elasticity is provided by physical cross-linking (styrenic block copolymers) or by dynamic vulcanization (TPV). TPE can be recycled and reprocessed; TPV contains an already cross-linked rubber phase and combines the processability of a TPE with the durability of a thermoset rubber.

blocks.zh: 配方保密性（Trade Secret）：不同供應商的彈性體配方不具化學等效性，任何供應商切換均需重新驗證（包括穩定性試驗及法規申報），是 PFS 供應商管理的高風險變更項目。
blocks.en: Formulation confidentiality (trade secret): Elastomer formulations from different suppliers are not chemically equivalent. Any supplier change requires revalidation (including stability studies and regulatory filings), which makes it a high-risk change item in PFS supplier management.

blocks.zh: 熱固性橡膠如烤好的蛋糕——加熱成型後無法還原，只能切割使用，不能重新融化；熱塑性彈性體如熱熔膠——加熱可流動重塑，冷卻後恢復彈性。TPV 則是「半熟」狀態——橡膠相已交聯但外殼熱塑，兼具兩者優點。
blocks.en: Thermoset rubber is like a baked cake: once shaped by heat it cannot be reverted, only cut, and it cannot be melted again. A thermoplastic elastomer is like hot-melt glue: it flows and can be reshaped when heated, and regains its elasticity on cooling. A TPV is "half-baked": the rubber phase is cross-linked while the matrix is thermoplastic, giving the benefits of both.

blocks.zh: 滅菌滲透性是針頭護罩材料的核心需求：EO 或蒸汽必須能滲透彈性體壁以滅菌針頭表面，殘留 EO 也必須能逸出。這要求彈性體具有高滲透性（high permeability），而這一特性與傳統瓶蓋或注射器活塞橡膠的低滲透性需求相反。因此，針頭護罩專用配方（polyisoprene、SBR）與活塞橡膠配方無法互換。
blocks.en: Sterilant permeability is a core requirement for needle-shield materials: EO or steam must be able to penetrate the elastomer wall to sterilize the needle surface, and residual EO must also be able to escape. This calls for high permeability, which is the opposite of the low-permeability requirement for traditional vial closures and syringe plunger stoppers. Therefore needle-shield formulations (polyisoprene, SBR) and plunger-stopper formulations are not interchangeable.

blocks.zh: 老化風險：臭氧攻擊（ozone attack）可導致彈性體脆化或龜裂，影響 CCI。長期儲存條件（溫度、濕度、UV 暴露）應納入針頭護罩材料評選標準。
blocks.en: Aging risk: Ozone attack can make elastomers brittle or cause cracking, compromising CCI. Long-term storage conditions (temperature, humidity, UV exposure) should be included in the needle-shield material selection criteria.

blocks.zh: 為什麼高滲透性彈性體（適合針頭護罩）不適合用作注射器活塞橡膠？請從 CCI 角度分析。
blocks.en: Why is a high-permeability elastomer (suitable for needle shields) unsuitable as a syringe plunger stopper? Analyze from a CCI perspective.

blocks.zh: 若客戶要求從 A 供應商彈性體配方切換至 B 供應商，Amaran 應要求客戶提供哪些技術文件，並觸發哪些驗證活動？
blocks.en: If a customer asks to switch from Supplier A's elastomer formulation to Supplier B's, what technical documents should Amaran require from the customer, and what validation activities should be triggered?

blocks.zh: 8.2.1 Needle-Shield Extractables Profile 針頭護罩可萃取物輪廓
blocks.en: 8.2.1 Needle-Shield Extractables Profile

blocks.zh: Extractables（可萃取物）：在極端溶劑條件下，從彈性體中可萃取出的化學物質，用以預測潛在滲出物風險。這是供應商責任範圍，應包含在 DMF 或 CoA 中。
blocks.en: Extractables: Chemical substances that can be extracted from the elastomer under aggressive solvent conditions, used to predict potential leachables risk. This is the supplier's responsibility and should be included in the DMF or CoA.

blocks.zh: USP <381> 雙重合規點：測試時機有兩個——（1）供應商出廠狀態及（2）最終就緒使用狀態（Ready-to-Use），兩個節點均需合規。這對已經過清洗、矽油化處理的護罩特別重要。
blocks.en: USP <381> dual compliance points: There are two test points: (1) the supplier's as-shipped state and (2) the final ready-to-use state; compliance is required at both. This is especially important for shields that have been washed and siliconized.

blocks.zh: RNS 的塑料外殼（rigid portion）需同時符合 USP <381> 及 ISO 10993（醫療器材生物評估）。ISO 10993 是組合產品監管的關鍵標準，Amaran 在審查 RNS 供應商資料時須確認兩者均已覆蓋。
blocks.en: The plastic shell (rigid portion) of an RNS must comply with both USP <381> and ISO 10993 (biological evaluation of medical devices). ISO 10993 is a key standard for combination product regulation; when reviewing RNS supplier data, Amaran must confirm that both are covered.

blocks.zh: 毒理學評估（Toxicological Evaluation）應由客戶的毒理學部門完成，並形成書面結論後歸入 PFS 技術檔案（Technical File / CTD Module 3.2.P.2）。
blocks.en: The toxicological evaluation should be completed by the customer's toxicology function, with a documented conclusion filed in the PFS technical file (Technical File / CTD Module 3.2.P.2).

blocks.zh: USP <381> 的「出廠狀態」與「就緒使用狀態」測試結果不一致時，應如何處理？從監管申報角度分析。
blocks.en: What should be done when the USP <381> results for the "as-shipped" and "ready-to-use" states are inconsistent? Analyze from a regulatory filing perspective.

blocks.zh: 若客戶毒理學評估發現某可萃取物超出安全閾值（TTC），Amaran 作為 CDMO 可以採取哪些控制措施？
blocks.en: If the customer's toxicological evaluation finds that an extractable exceeds the safety threshold (TTC), what control measures can Amaran, as a CDMO, take?

blocks.zh: 8.2.2 Needle-Shield Leachables Profile 針頭護罩滲出物輪廓
blocks.en: 8.2.2 Needle-Shield Leachables Profile

blocks.zh: Leachables（滲出物）vs Extractables（可萃取物）：可萃取物是壓力測試（worst-case）的預測性資料；滲出物是在實際產品儲存條件下真正遷移進入藥液的物質。接觸面積雖小，但針頭插入彈性體後接觸面積的微觀品質（壓配緊密程度、時間、溫度）均影響滲出速率。
blocks.en: Leachables vs extractables: Extractables are predictive (worst-case) data from stress testing; leachables are the substances that actually migrate into the drug solution under real product storage conditions. Although the contact area is small, the microscopic quality of the contact once the needle is inserted into the elastomer (tightness of the fit, time, temperature) all influence the leaching rate.

blocks.zh: 滲出物就像茶葉泡入水中的茶色素——接觸面積雖然只是葉片表面，但足夠長的時間仍可使茶水顏色明顯改變。針頭端的接觸面積看似微小，但在 24 個月儲存期內積累的遷移量仍可能達到藥品安全閾值。
blocks.en: Leachables are like the tea pigment released when tea leaves are steeped in water: the contact area is only the surface of the leaves, yet given enough time the color of the tea changes noticeably. The contact area at the needle end looks tiny, but the amount that migrates over a 24-month shelf life can still reach the drug safety threshold.

blocks.zh: TR73 明確點出已有多起實際滲出物案例被報告於 PFS 藥品。這是監管機構（FDA、EMA）在 PFS CMC 審查中特別關注的項目。Amaran 在技術協議中應要求客戶提供針頭端滲出物研究計畫（Leachables Study Protocol）並確認完成時程。
blocks.en: TR73 explicitly notes that several actual cases of leachables have been reported in PFS drug products. This is an area that regulators (FDA, EMA) pay particular attention to in PFS CMC review. In the technical agreement, Amaran should require the customer to provide a needle-end leachables study protocol and confirm the completion timeline.

blocks.zh: 8.2.3 Needle-Shield E-beam Compatibility 電子束相容性
blocks.en: 8.2.3 Needle-Shield E-beam Compatibility

blocks.zh: E-beam（電子束）表面滅菌：在灌裝線上對充填後密封的 PFS 進行表面殺菌，是近年無菌製造的新興技術。輻射劑量（kGy）是關鍵參數，需透過劑量映射（Dose Mapping）確認。
blocks.en: E-beam surface sterilization: Surface decontamination of filled and sealed PFS on the filling line; an emerging aseptic manufacturing technology in recent years. The radiation dose (kGy) is a critical parameter and must be confirmed by dose mapping.

blocks.zh: 延遲老化效應：輻射對彈性體的氧化降解可能在照射後數週至數月才顯現（Post-Irradiation Aging）。因此，材料相容性評估需包含加速老化試驗，而不僅是即時測試。
blocks.en: Delayed aging effect: Oxidative degradation of elastomers by radiation may only appear weeks to months after irradiation (post-irradiation aging). Material compatibility assessment therefore needs to include accelerated aging studies, not just immediate testing.

blocks.zh: Amaran 若評估引入 E-beam 表面滅菌，應要求針頭護罩供應商提供經驗證的輻射相容性資料（包含加速老化），並在工程批次中確認 CCI 是否受影響。這屬於製程驗證中的容器密封相容性子研究。
blocks.en: If Amaran evaluates introducing e-beam surface sterilization, it should require the needle-shield supplier to provide validated radiation compatibility data (including accelerated aging) and confirm in engineering batches whether CCI is affected. This falls under the container closure compatibility sub-study within process validation.

blocks.zh: 8.2.4 Needle-Shield Elastomer Cleanliness 彈性體潔淨度
blocks.en: 8.2.4 Needle-Shield Elastomer Cleanliness

blocks.zh: 彈性體潔淨度（Cleanliness）：彈性體在模製後表面可能殘留纖維（fiber）、微粒（particulate）或模具釋放劑。這些汙染物在針頭組裝時可能被帶入無菌空間，成為不溶性微粒的潛在來源。清洗方法（水洗、超音波清洗等）及潔淨度驗收標準應在供應商資格確認（Supplier Qualification）中明確規範。
blocks.en: Elastomer cleanliness: After molding, the elastomer surface may carry residual fibers, particulates or mold release agents. During needle assembly these contaminants may be carried into the aseptic space and become a potential source of subvisible particles. Cleaning methods (water washing, ultrasonic cleaning, etc.) and cleanliness acceptance criteria should be clearly specified in supplier qualification.

blocks.zh: USP <789>（注射用液體中的不溶性微粒）是充填後 PFS 的微粒控制標準。針頭護罩的潔淨度直接影響充填後微粒計數結果。Amaran 應在供應商稽核（Supplier Audit）中確認彈性體清洗 SOP 及批次潔淨度放行數據。
blocks.en: USP <789> (subvisible particulate matter in injectable liquids) is the particulate control standard for filled PFS. Needle-shield cleanliness directly affects particle counts in the filled product. In supplier audits, Amaran should confirm the elastomer cleaning SOP and batch cleanliness release data.

blocks.zh: 8.3 Mechanical Property Requirements 機械性能要求
blocks.en: 8.3 Mechanical Property Requirements

blocks.zh: 機械性能要求包含兩個核心指標：（1）拔除力（Pull-off Force）——確保護罩在使用前不脫落且使用時可順利移除；（2）針尖鋒利度（Needle Sharpness）——確保護罩組裝後針尖穿刺力不受損。兩者均直接影響患者安全與產品 CQA。
blocks.en: Mechanical property requirements cover two core attributes: (1) pull-off force, which ensures the shield does not come off before use and can be removed smoothly at use; and (2) needle sharpness, which ensures needle-tip penetration force is not compromised after shield assembly. Both directly affect patient safety and the product CQAs.

blocks.zh: 8.3.1 Needle-Shield Pull-off Force 針頭護罩拔除力
blocks.en: 8.3.1 Needle-Shield Pull-off Force

blocks.zh: Pull-off Force 規格的雙重目的：
blocks.en: The pull-off force specification has a dual purpose:

blocks.zh: 最小值：確保儲存、運輸、灌裝線操作中護罩不意外脫落（CCI 要求）
blocks.en: Minimum value: ensures the shield does not come off accidentally during storage, transport and filling-line handling (a CCI requirement)

blocks.zh: 最大值：確保患者（尤其是老年人、關節炎患者）或自動注射器機構能夠順利拔除
blocks.en: Maximum value: ensures that patients (especially the elderly and those with arthritis) or the autoinjector mechanism can remove it smoothly

blocks.zh:
RNS 的力量層級要求（Force Hierarchy）：
塑料外殼與彈性體的分離力 > RNS 整體從注射筒拔除力
這確保拔除時 RNS 作為整體移除，而非外殼先脫離，導致彈性體殘留在針尖上。
blocks.en:
Force hierarchy for an RNS:
Force to separate the plastic shell from the elastomer > force to pull the whole RNS off the syringe
This ensures that the RNS is removed as a single unit, rather than the shell detaching first and leaving the elastomer on the needle tip.

blocks.zh: 拔除力就像車門的鎖緊力——太鬆車門自動彈開（安全風險），太緊老人和兒童無法開門（使用性問題）。RNS 的力量層級就像「車門整體 vs 車窗」——開車門時必須整扇門一起打開，而不是窗戶先飛出去。
blocks.en: Pull-off force is like the latch force of a car door: too loose and the door pops open on its own (a safety risk); too tight and the elderly and children cannot open it (a usability problem). The RNS force hierarchy is like "the whole door vs the window": when you open the door, the entire door must open together, not the window flying out first.

blocks.zh: 空針 vs 充填後的拔除力差異：TR73 明確警告，空針測試結果不一定能預測充填後結果。充填後藥液壓力、矽油遷移、長期儲存等因素均可改變彈性體的摩擦係數和尺寸，導致拔除力漂移。Amaran 應在穩定性研究設計中納入充填後拔除力測試時間點（T0、T6、T12、T24 months）。
blocks.en: Pull-off force differences between empty and filled syringes: TR73 explicitly warns that test results on empty syringes do not necessarily predict results after filling. Drug solution pressure, silicone oil migration and long-term storage can all change the elastomer's coefficient of friction and dimensions, causing pull-off force drift. Amaran should include filled-syringe pull-off force time points in the stability study design (T0, T6, T12, T24 months).

blocks.zh: ISO 11040-4 是拔除力測試方法的主要參考標準，應作為品質協議（Quality Agreement）中測試方法的正式引用依據。
blocks.en: ISO 11040-4 is the main reference standard for the pull-off force test method and should be formally cited as the test method basis in the Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh: 若穩定性試驗顯示充填後拔除力隨時間顯著增加，可能的原因有哪些？應採取什麼矯正措施？
blocks.en: If a stability study shows that the pull-off force of filled syringes increases significantly over time, what are the possible causes? What corrective actions should be taken?

blocks.zh: 一個兼容自動注射器的 PFS 產品，拔除力規格應如何與自動注射器的驅動機構設計協調確認？由哪方負責主導？
blocks.en: For a PFS product compatible with an autoinjector, how should the pull-off force specification be coordinated and confirmed with the autoinjector drive mechanism design? Which party should lead?

blocks.zh: 8.3.2 Influence of Needle Shield on Needle Sharpness 針頭護罩對針尖鋒利度的影響
blocks.en: 8.3.2 Influence of Needle Shield on Needle Sharpness

blocks.zh: 針尖鋒利度（Needle Sharpness）：以穿刺力（Penetration Force）量化，測試方法依 ISO 11040-4 執行。針頭護罩的彈性體雖包覆針尖，但正常的橡膠硬度不應使針尖變鈍。異常鈍化通常源於：（1）組裝時針尖撞擊模具壁、（2）彈性體過硬導致針尖彎曲、（3）儲存期間針尖腐蝕（與護罩材料不相容）。
blocks.en: Needle sharpness: Quantified by penetration force, with the test method performed per ISO 11040-4. Although the needle-shield elastomer encloses the needle tip, normal rubber hardness should not blunt the tip. Abnormal blunting usually arises from: (1) the needle tip hitting the mold wall during assembly, (2) an overly hard elastomer bending the tip, or (3) tip corrosion during storage (incompatibility with the shield material).

blocks.zh: 鋒利度測試通常在進料檢驗（Incoming Inspection）時執行，採統計抽樣計畫（AQL 計畫），並與供應商品質協議明確規範驗收標準（Acceptance Criteria）。若發現鋒利度不符，需啟動偏差調查（Deviation Investigation）並追蹤至供應商製程。
blocks.en: Sharpness testing is usually performed at incoming inspection using a statistical sampling plan (AQL plan), with acceptance criteria clearly specified in the supplier quality agreement. If sharpness is found nonconforming, a deviation investigation must be initiated and traced back to the supplier's process.

blocks.zh: 8.4 Container Closure Integrity Requirements 容器密封完整性要求
blocks.en: 8.4 Container Closure Integrity Requirements

blocks.zh: CCI 在針頭護罩端的評估分為兩個維度：（1）空針 CCI（供應商 / 進料驗收階段）和（2）充填後全生命週期 CCI（藥廠責任）。兩者的測試策略、方法與驗收標準均有所不同，詳細方法見 §12.4。
blocks.en: CCI assessment at the needle-shield end has two dimensions: (1) empty-syringe CCI (supplier / incoming acceptance stage) and (2) filled-syringe CCI throughout the life cycle (drug manufacturer's responsibility). The test strategy, methods and acceptance criteria differ between the two; see §12.4 for detailed methods.

blocks.zh: 8.4.1 Empty Syringe 空針容器密封完整性
blocks.en: 8.4.1 Empty Syringe

blocks.zh: 三類關鍵缺陷（Critical Defects）：
blocks.en: Three categories of critical defects:

blocks.zh: 撕裂/龜裂（Tears/Cracks）：直接破壞微生物屏障，任何數量均為拒收
blocks.en: Tears/cracks: Directly breach the microbial barrier; any occurrence is rejected

blocks.zh: 針頭穿出（Needle Protrusion）：針尖貫穿護罩，安全風險且 CCI 喪失
blocks.en: Needle protrusion: The needle tip penetrates the shield, creating a safety risk and loss of CCI

blocks.zh: 尺寸不符（Dimensional Nonconformity）：護罩壓配深度不足或過深，影響干涉配合密封效果
blocks.en: Dimensional nonconformity: Insufficient or excessive shield fitting depth, affecting the interference-fit seal

blocks.zh: 雙向抽樣計畫：供應商出貨檢驗（OQC）與客戶進料檢驗（IQC）各自執行，兩者的抽樣計畫及 AQL 設定應在品質協議中對齊，避免重複測試或覆蓋空白。
blocks.en: Two-sided sampling plans: Supplier outgoing inspection (OQC) and customer incoming inspection (IQC) are each performed; the sampling plans and AQL settings of the two should be aligned in the quality agreement to avoid duplicate testing or coverage gaps.

blocks.zh: 品質協議（Quality Agreement）是 CDMO 與客戶之間正式確認 CCI 控制責任分工的法規文件（參照 FDA Guidance on Pharmaceutical Quality Agreement, 2016）。Amaran 作為灌裝方，在接收供應商空針時的進料 CCI 目視檢查責任必須在協議中明確定義，不可默認由供應商全權負責。
blocks.en: The Quality Agreement is the formal document by which the CDMO and the customer confirm the division of CCI control responsibilities (see FDA Guidance on Pharmaceutical Quality Agreement, 2016). As the filler, Amaran's responsibility for incoming visual CCI inspection of supplier empty syringes must be clearly defined in the agreement and must not be assumed to rest entirely with the supplier.

blocks.zh: 若進料檢驗發現 0.5% 的空針出現針頭護罩輕微撕裂，應觸發什麼等級的品質事件（Minor / Major / Critical）？依據什麼判斷？
blocks.en: If incoming inspection finds slight tears in the needle shields of 0.5% of empty syringes, what level of quality event (Minor / Major / Critical) should be triggered? On what basis?

blocks.zh: 供應商 OQC 放行但客戶 IQC 發現缺陷，兩個抽樣計畫的 AQL 設定應如何協調？
blocks.en: When the supplier's OQC releases a lot but the customer's IQC finds defects, how should the AQL settings of the two sampling plans be reconciled?

blocks.zh: 8.4.2 Filled Syringe throughout the Life Cycle 充填針劑的全生命週期密封完整性
blocks.en: 8.4.2 Filled Syringe throughout the Life Cycle

blocks.zh: 全生命週期 CCI（Life Cycle CCI）：充填後的 PFS 需在以下全程保持 CCI：灌裝冷凍乾燥（如適用）→ 目視檢驗 → 包裝 → 加速穩定性 → 真實穩定性（直至效期末）→ 模擬運輸（Distribution Simulation）。每個階段均可能對針頭護罩產生不同的機械應力。
blocks.en: Life cycle CCI: Filled PFS must maintain CCI throughout the following stages: filling, lyophilization (if applicable) → visual inspection → packaging → accelerated stability → real-time stability (through end of shelf life) → distribution simulation. Each stage may subject the needle shield to a different mechanical stress.

blocks.zh: 目視可見的表面裂紋（Surface Cracks）是全部充填批次 100% 目視檢驗的拒收標準（Critical Defect）。裸眼可見裂紋意味著 CCI 已失效，任何此類產品均不得放行。CCI 確認方法詳見 §12.4，包含微生物浸入法、壓力衰減法、高壓液相色譜法等確定性方法。
blocks.en: Visible surface cracks are a rejection criterion (critical defect) in 100% visual inspection of all filled batches. A crack visible to the naked eye means CCI has failed, and no such product may be released. See §12.4 for CCI confirmation methods, including deterministic methods such as microbial ingress, pressure decay and HPLC.

blocks.zh: 8.5 Dimensional Requirements 尺寸相容性要求
blocks.en: 8.5 Dimensional Requirements

blocks.zh: 組合產品尺寸相容性（Dimensional Compatibility）：當 PFS 與自動注射器（Autoinjector）或安全裝置（Safety Device）組合使用時，針頭護罩的外徑、長度、硬度（Shore A）均影響組合產品的啟動力和功能。這些尺寸需在設計凍結（Design Freeze）前完成跨組件相容性確認（Interface Design Verification）。
blocks.en: Dimensional compatibility of the combination product: When a PFS is combined with an autoinjector or safety device, the needle-shield outer diameter, length and hardness (Shore A) all affect the activation force and function of the combination product. These dimensions must be confirmed through cross-component compatibility (interface design verification) before design freeze.

blocks.zh: 開發階段的前置協調：TR73 強調此協調必須在開發階段完成，而非量產後再修正。這呼應 ICH Q8 的品質源於設計（QbD）原則：組合產品設計空間（Design Space）需包含所有接口尺寸的容差分析（Tolerance Stack-up Analysis）。
blocks.en: Up-front coordination during development: TR73 stresses that this coordination must be completed during development, not corrected after commercial production begins. This echoes the quality by design (QbD) principle of ICH Q8: the design space of the combination product must include a tolerance stack-up analysis of all interface dimensions.

blocks.zh: 尺寸相容性就像 USB 接頭的規格統一——USB-A 與 USB-C 不相容，若在量產後才發現接頭型式不匹配，重新開模的成本遠高於設計期間的評估成本。PFS 與自動注射器的尺寸介面若在後期才發現不相容，需要的設計變更（Design Change）將觸發全面的重新驗證，耗時耗資。
blocks.en: Dimensional compatibility is like standardizing USB connectors: USB-A and USB-C are not compatible, and if a connector mismatch is found only after mass production, the cost of re-tooling far exceeds the cost of evaluating it during design. If a dimensional incompatibility between a PFS and an autoinjector is found late, the resulting design change will trigger full revalidation, costing time and money.

blocks.zh: TR73 明確說明組合產品詳細設計規範超出本技術報告範疇，但仍標注其重要性。實際開發中，ISO 11608 系列標準（特別是 ISO 11608-1 及 ISO 11608-5）提供了針頭型注射系統與組合裝置的功能要求框架。Amaran 在接受含自動注射器的組合產品開發委託時，應在 Design Input Requirements 中明確列入針頭護罩尺寸的介面規格項目。
blocks.en: TR73 states that detailed design specifications for combination products are beyond the scope of this technical report, but still notes their importance. In actual development, the ISO 11608 series (especially ISO 11608-1 and ISO 11608-5) provides a framework of functional requirements for needle-based injection systems and combination devices. When accepting a combination product development project that includes an autoinjector, Amaran should explicitly list the needle-shield dimensional interface specifications in the Design Input Requirements.

blocks.zh: 若在 Phase III 臨床試驗期間，客戶決定將針頭護罩從非硬質改為 RNS 以提升自動注射器相容性，這項變更在法規申報上屬於什麼等級（Major / Moderate / Minor）？需要哪些補充數據？
blocks.en: If, during Phase III clinical trials, the customer decides to change the needle shield from non-rigid to RNS to improve autoinjector compatibility, what level does this change fall under for regulatory filing (Major / Moderate / Minor)? What supporting data are required?

blocks.zh: Tolerance Stack-up Analysis（公差疊加分析）在確認 PFS 與自動注射器介面相容性時如何應用？誰應負責執行——PFS 供應商、自動注射器製造商，還是藥品持有人？
blocks.en: How is tolerance stack-up analysis applied to confirm interface compatibility between a PFS and an autoinjector? Who should perform it: the PFS supplier, the autoinjector manufacturer or the drug product holder?
